data.one_liner: Configurable Dart/Flutter formatter that never wraps lines unless requested
data.what_it_does: Formats Dart and Flutter source code according to user‑defined rules such as brace placement, spacing, and indentation. It can run as a CLI, read from stdin, or expose a long‑running HTTP service used by IDE plugins.
use_when: Formatting code in CI or pre‑commit hooks
Integrating formatting into IDEs via JetBrains or VS Code extensions
Customizing line breaks and spacing beyond the default dart format
avoid_when: You prefer the opinionated built‑in dart format
You need a formatter that automatically wraps lines at a column limit
strengths: Never inserts line breaks unless explicitly enabled
Supports CLI, stdin, and HTTP service for editor integration
weaknesses: Not part of the Dart SDK, requires separate installation
Limited to formatting, no linting or analysis
data.setup_notes: Run `dart pub global activate dart_format` and add the executable to PATH. No additional permissions or build_runner needed.
data.minimal_example:
```sh
# Format a single file
dart_format lib/main.dart

# Format all .dart files under lib/ and test/
dart_format lib test
```
